Smith Center]] |champion= |bowl= |bowl_result= }} {{2018–19 Atlantic 10 men's basketball standings}} The '''2018–19 George Washington Colonials men's basketball team''' represented [[George Washington University]] during the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Colonials were led by third-year head coach [[Maurice Joseph]] and played their home games at the [[Charles E. Smith Center]] in [[Washington, D.C.]] as members of the [[Atlantic 10 Conference]]. They finished the season9–24, 4–14 in [[2018–19 Atlantic 10 Conference men's basketball season|A-10 play]] to finish in a tie for 12th place. As the No. 12 seed, they defeated [[2018–19 UMass Minutemen basketball team|Massachusetts]] in the first round of the [[2019 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament|A-10 tournament]] before losing to [[2018–19 George Mason Patriots men's basketball team|George Mason]] in the second round. George Washington parted ways with Maurice Joseph on March 15, 2019 after three seasons and an overall record of 44–57.{{cite news|url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/sports/2019/03/15/george-washington-fires-basketball-coach-maurice-joseph-after-three-seasons/|title=George Washington fires basketball coach Maurice Joseph after three seasons|last=Bonesteel|first=Matt|date=March 15, 2019|newspaper=[[The Washington Post]]|accessdate=March 15, 2019}} On March 21, the school hired [[Siena Saints men's basketball|Siena]] head coach [[Jamion Christian]] as the new head coach.{{cite news|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/26323454/george-washington-hires-siena-coach-christian|title=George Washington hires Siena coach Christian|last=Borzello|first=Jeff|date=March 21, 2019|accessdate=March 21, 2019|website=ESPN.com}} ==Previous season== The [[2017–18 George Washington Colonials men's basketball team|Colonials]] finished the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2017–18 season]] with a record of 15–18, 7–11 in [[2017–18 Atlantic 10 Conference men's basketball season|A-10 play]] to finish in a three-way tie for 10th place. They defeated [[2017–18 Fordham Rams men's basketball team|Fordham]] in the first round of the [[2018 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament|A-10 tournament]] before losing to [[2017–18 Saint Louis Billikens men's basketball team|Saint Louis]] in the second round. == Offseason == === Departures === {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
